description: wigolo test/run environment: Node 22 (matches CI) plus the runtime libraries Playwright's bundled Chromium needs on NixOS, which has no /usr/lib.

init_hook: # devbox's own package farm drops glib's and dbus's /lib — the two the browser needs most — so the libs come from a buildEnv in devbox.d/playwright-libs.

scripts.test: npm run build && bash scripts/test-hermetic.sh run
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && bash scripts/test-hermetic.sh run tests/integration
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && bash scripts/test-hermetic.sh run tests/e2e
